Per-candidate influence pieces (Cox / GLM dispatch)

Source: R/fs_mr_inference.R
dot-fs_mr_pieces.Rd

Thin dispatch onto the existing forestsearch internals so MR uses the identical treatment dfbeta, beta_hat, and robust sigma_D the resample consistency engine uses.

Usage

.fs_mr_pieces(df_sub, spec)

Arguments

df_sub

Data frame for one candidate subgroup's members.

spec

List with outcome_type, effect_measure, treat.name, outcome.name, event.name, offset.name, adjust_covariates, adverse_outcome.

Value

Output of .consistency_glm_pieces() / .consistency_cox_pieces(), or NULL.
